g.text: KayaRank5Convo2 begins.
How about I ask *you* about time travel this time?
Nah. Let's talk about something else actually! Ok?
Check boolean KayaPromiseRegret
Like my biggest regret?
true
Like what? You choose.
false
How about... Kalymos?
false
Hmm okay yeah sure. What is it?
Ummm I guess... my first pet?
Yeah Yeah she's fine, I'm more of a dog girl though. Grew up with one. I wish I could see him again.
Not demanding more from Albrecht.
Not stopping Ballas sooner.
Giving up on myself.
Although that's usually one of those hacker internet questions so uhh don't tell anyone.
My sympathies. It's best to end here [End.]
I'm sorry to hear, tell me about him.
I've lost a pet too. What was his name?
It's like even after all this I just let him get away.
I don't know how I could have changed things.
It doesn't matter what it looks like to anyone else. There was a point when no one hated me more than myself.
But his name was Zylo. You'd call him a Kubrow I think.
+20 Chemistry
It's kind of unfair actually. Entrati gets to time travel around with his freaky-feline?
I know he thinks he's teaching me something, but that asshole doesn't even realize what he put me through.
But I know that if I was even a minute faster, someone would have suffered less.
I couldn't even DIE. And I wished I could.
HUGE, like biggest dog you could imagine. Could bite Mr. Volkov in half I bet.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo3.
If I had Zylo with me... this trip would be a lot easier.
And not JUST me. All of us. And Loid, Gomaitru... it's sickening. I don't know if I'll be able to hold back if I see him.
Ballas is everything I fear. He's the worst of life itself.
When you put it this way.. I guess life and people just kind of sucks sometimes doesn't it?
We've still got big Kubrows where I'm from!
Ehh I don't know, Mr. Volkov is pretty tough.
Zylo was the first living thing to see me cry, you know.
But then sometimes it's so awesome.
Oh my god... all the more reason for me to GET THERE. Wow!
Actually you might have a point... but anyway, big scary Zylo. But he was fiercely protective of me.
I was like 5 years old, and as long as I can remember I refused to cry.
We can't define ourselves by our biggest regret I guess. I feel like you helped me move on from mine.
My Zylo was fiercely protective of me.
But I got home from my first day of first grade at school and Zylo was there.
But I wouldn't change that it happened.
And he followed me to my room and guarded the door while I just sobbed.
Because like, I don't hate this for me. Nova? Kind of the coolest thing ever.
What made you so upset?
How do you remember that?
You wouldn't change a thing?
Someone called me fat.
How could I forget?!
Not a damn thing. And I hope you wouldn't either.
Which was like, the thing that made kids unpopular when I grew up.
Someone called me fat.
+20 Chemistry
Kids can be so cruel.
Is being popular that important?
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo3.
Everyone is cruel.
It was... until all this happened. I feel like I'm a better person after all this shit, like, I am who I truly should have been this whole time.
Everyone wants to be the cool kid.
No more caring about what people think of me. Just.. getting to finally live.
But I've realized now, it's way cooler to not care about being cool. That's why you're so cool.
+20 Chemistry
I feel like I'm a better person after all this shit, like, I am who I truly should have been this whole time.
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo3.
No more caring about what people think of me. Just.. getting to finally live.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo3.
